description:
Ask sales@autonet.work for a monthly credit allowance, normally 1000/month.
    Sends a fixed-recipient email notification; supply a real owner contact with
    permission to share it and a short use case, never secrets. Reuse request_key.
    No automatic payment, invoice or credit grant. Read utility_account for status.
    Sales agrees terms and invoices separately; admin approves credit allowances.
    Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.
name: request_monthly_credits
